info.title: Orazaka — law corpus read API
info.description: The dated, hashed text of the law (ADR-089 §2, §9), read through the engine's single door (ADR-068). Hand-written until krizaka/orazaka#238 generates contracts/openapi/ from the controllers; scripts/test/openapi-law.test.mjs pins it.

servers.description: the edge; an oz_ key is exchanged there for a session

get.summary: The text of an article as it was in force on a day.
get.description: Served by orazaka-conversation-service (LawArticleController → orazaka-tools LawArticleReadService). asOf is required: no day is read from a clock. The text is served only when it still gives the content_hash recorded with its row (fail closed: law-integrity-error, no text). An optional quote is checked against the text under the corpus normaliser (NFC, whitespace collapsed), deterministically. Metered as one RESEARCH CALL on provider law-corpus: held after validation, settled only on FOUND (whatever the quote check), released on every other outcome; an invalid question and a switched-off corpus hold nothing. With no meter wired the read is refused (503), never served unmetered.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: The day the text must be in force (ISO yyyy-MM-dd). Required; a caller that wants « today » sends its own calendar day (America/Toronto for QC).

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Words to check against the article text. Not blank when sent.

200.description: FOUND: the version in force on asOf, its hash checked. Charged: one CALL.

X-Orazaka-Read-Id.description: The identifier the read was metered under.

400.description: A part of the question is missing or unreadable (asOf included). Nothing held.

401.description: No session (and no oz_ key exchanged by the edge).

402.description: The caller's budget or credits cannot hold the call. Nothing read.

404.description: LAW_VERSION_UNKNOWN: no version of this article is known for that day. Not charged.

500.description: LAW_INTEGRITY_ERROR: the stored text no longer gives its recorded hash; no text. Not charged.

503.description: LAW_CORPUS_DISABLED (law.corpus.enabled is false: the operator's switch, temporary, not the caller's question) or LAW_METERING_UNAVAILABLE (no meter wired). Nothing held.

bearer.description: A session JWT, or an oz_ key that the edge exchanges for one.

text.description: The normalised text (label and subsections; the historical note is not part of it).

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the normalised text, checked on this read.

officialUrl.description: The publisher's page, the address a citation shows.

importId.description: The law_import that brought this text in.

quote.description: The quote check, when a quote was sent.

code.description: The stable slug a client branches on.

outcome.description: The corpus outcome name (LAW_VERSION_UNKNOWN …), as the lookupStatute tool says it; absent on invalid-request.
